text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the day's training is done, I decide to go over our upcoming schedule. As I take out my notebook…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It slips out of my hands… and drops smack into a puddle.
choice_data_list: Sigh… Looks like I need a new notebook…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um, I can make a cover for it if you like?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes! It won't be able to fix the damage, but it should help protect your notebook a bit longer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I appreciate the thought, but I don't want it to take up Nishino Flower's free time.
choice_data_list: I couldn't ask you to go through the trouble.

text_block_list.text: Aw shucks, what a waste!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: You're turning down the chance to get your hands on a handmade cover from Flower? They're the best around.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: The cover she made for my tackle box has been tough enough to withstand every kind of adverse element I've subjected it to.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yep, and it works like a dream. I'd like to ask her to make me another one, honestly.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I wasn't sure how well it would turn out since I made it from a pattern template, but I'm glad you like it so much!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I've still got plenty of fabric left over, so I'd be glad to make you another tackle box cover!
Mmm? In that case, I would like to put in a request as well! Could you make me something I can use while conducting research?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: The arm covers you crafted for me are peerless in terms of quality!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: They've shielded my arm against countless mishaps, from explosions to chemical spills!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Precisely! What's more, the covers' texture is outstanding, making them extremely comfortable to wear!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I'm deeply intrigued by their strength and composition. Such qualities could be put to practical use in my research.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: So I ask, in the name of scientific progress! Please construct another pair of arm covers for me!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: No… Let's embark on a joint research project instead! You may use my laboratory as you see fit. How does that grab you?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Th-thank you. I'm glad to see you're so passionate about my arm covers.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: But I'm happy just making them my usual way. We don't need to do anything extreme in a lab!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: No kiddin'! Flower's covers are all the rip-roarin' rage!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Taiki! R-rip… roaring?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yeah! The grip cover ya made for my revolver's perfect for practicin' my gun spinnin'!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: No matter how roughed up it gets or how many times I drop it, it never so much as frays!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: They don't make 'em that good in the States, I tell ya!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: In other words, what she's offering is the real deal!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before we know it, we're surrounded by passionate devotees of Nishino Flower's handmade covers. They shower her work with effusive praise.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I had no idea everyone was so pleased with them… I only made those covers for fun. If anything, I thought I was just being a bother…

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: A bother? No way!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um, I, uh… Thank you! I'm so happy that you like my work!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ohh… My cheeks are burning up!
choice_data_list: Now I can't wait to see my new notebook cover.
Now I can't wait to see my new notebook cover.
No need to hide your feelings!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ohh… My cheeks are burning up!
choice_data_list: Now I can't wait to see my new notebook cover.
Now I can't wait to see my new notebook cover.
No need to hide your feelings!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: O-oh, right! One notebook cover coming right up!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'll put all my heart into it, so I hope it puts a smile on your face! And I'll make covers for everyone else, of course!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yet another fan joins the ranks… Well, what can you do?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: What?! You want me to express myself more than this?! I'm not even sure how…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: BOOM! Just puff out yer chest, Flower! Yer number one in everyone's hearts, don'tcha know!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Okay! Time to show you all my gratitude…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thanks, everyone! I really appreciate the nice things you said!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her devoted following quietly nods in unison at the sentiment.
